name: EPSY 5491
title: School Psychology Internship
description: Post practicum experience in School Psychology under the supervision of a fully trained and certified professional School Psychologist for the duration of one school year along with an accompanying on-campus seminar. All core courses in the School Psychology program must be completed prior to beginning the internship. May be repeated for a total of 12 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
